mapper.sql: n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.publish_status = 1 AND n.publish_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND ( n.community_managed = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_article pa LEFT JOIN user_account au ON au.id = pa.author_user_id AND au.is_deleted = 0 AND au.account_status = 1 WHERE pa.news_id = n.id AND pa.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( au.id IS NOT NULL OR ( pa.author_user_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_blogger eb WHERE eb.id = n.blogger_id AND eb.enabled = 1 AND eb.user_id IS NULL ) ) ) ) )

LN( 1.0 + GREATEST( 3.0 * GREATEST(COALESCE(n.like_count, 0), 0) + 5.0 * GREATEST(COALESCE(n.collect_count, 0), 0) + 4.0 * ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment cc WHERE cc.news_id = n.id AND cc.is_deleted = 0 AND cc.is_hidden = 0 AND cc.reply_to_comment_id IS NULL ) + 1.0 * ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_article_view rv WHERE rv.news_id = n.id ), 0 ) ) / POWER( GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, n.publish_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 0) + 12.0, 1.5 )
